title: Prove adaptive P104 rounding collisions and retained-history bounds
body:
Relative-accurate native children do not by themselves guarantee exact private cleanup. This package binds the adaptive stage-rounding kernel to the first literal physical P104 collector and proves a collision family for every relative precision b: 2^256 distinct inputs have the same returned field and grid. Even retaining all seven diagnostic totals leaves binomial(256,128) indistinguishable inputs, requiring at least 252 additional bits of state information for exact inversion from that transcript.

The fifteen-event execution leaves an explicit nonzero private residual while both completed native calls meet their relative-error contracts. A finer-policy control restores the fixed witness exactly. The theorem excludes a specified memoryless return interface; source-assisted repair, reversible history, absolute-grid recovery and the existing exact-internal mixed-grid result remain available under their own contracts.

Validation on Windows AMD64 / CPython 3.12.14: registered replay and metadata/source pins pass; all 512 exact native inverse columns, 15 sparse and four dense fixtures, an independent Fraction tie calculation, and nine behavioral groups pass. The tests include source corruption before execution, phase/cleanup/binding faults, strict erasure, typed receipt mutation and a read-only optimized Git-free export.

Reproduce:
```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-adaptive-rounding-collision
```

Credit ywz65/PR2586 for the physical word, Arham Tahir/PR2665 for the earlier same-grid collector example, PR2891 for the unchanged adaptive arithmetic, Nick Petalas/PR2771 for the block-scale/perturbation lemma, ywz65/PR2730 for the different positive mixed-grid contract, and PR2878 for conditional recovery. Full predecessor/native lineage is retained. New work is Apache-2.0, prepared for Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human or formal review claimed.

This is a changed-scope local lifecycle audit, not a supplier or kappa improvement. Full native ancestry, complete rounded caller, recursive/physical costs, all-size lowering, selected cold replay and hosted CI remain unrun. The family stops at this result; the next useful task is a priced reversible-history or source-assisted cleanup contract for a viable consumer.
